fusions.name: Driven to the Head
fusions.desc: Hammers a spike home, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tacked Down
fusions.desc: Strikes the ground around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, stunning each for 1 second, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Boarded and Nailed
fusions.desc: Nails up a barricade 4 tiles long that blocks enemies for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Each Blow Drives Deeper
fusions.desc: Every hit you land drives a stack into that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
